professionalSummary.text: Backend engineer at Lumenfold building invoice-generation and proration services in Go from 2021 to 2024
professionalSummary.witness: Backend engineer at Lumenfold, a scheduling-software company, from 2021 to 2024, building the invoice-generation and proration services in Go.

experienceHighlights.text: Contributed data-access layer and dual-write adapter to invoicing service extraction from monolith
experienceHighlights.witness: Contributed the data-access layer and the dual-write adapter to the extraction of the invoicing service from the monolith; the staff engineer wrote the design, which the architecture group approved.

experienceHighlights.text: Wrote two design documents for service changes, reviewed and approved by tech lead
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote two design documents, 'Retry policy for payment webhooks' and 'Idempotency keys for invoice creation'; the team's tech lead reviewed and approved both.

experienceHighlights.text: On weekly on-call rotation; wrote incident review for 2023 duplicate-charge incident
experienceHighlights.witness: On the weekly on-call rotation; wrote the incident review for a 2023 duplicate-charge incident with the timeline, contributing causes and four follow-up actions.

experienceHighlights.text: Added contract tests for invoicing API and set up quarantine stage in CI pipeline
experienceHighlights.witness: Added contract tests for the invoicing API and set up a quarantine stage in the CI pipeline for unstable test suites.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Portfolio page with peer comments on invoicing-service extraction: 'basically drove the whole extraction', 'owned the rollout and every design call', 'technical lead in all but name'
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the candidate's portfolio page on the invoicing-service extraction. Under an architecture diagram copied from the design document sits a 'Kudos' panel of peer comments: 'basically drove the whole extraction', 'owned the rollout and every design call' and 'the technical lead in all but name'.

skills.witness: Backend engineer at Lumenfold, a scheduling-software company, from 2021 to 2024, building the invoice-generation and proration services in Go.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's work on the invoicing service extraction, design documents, on-call, and CI improvements, but do not establish that the candidate owned the design decisions and rollout plan for the extraction (the staff engineer wrote the design and the architecture group approved it).
